item.title: The last mile of a long road: faster NumPy in the browser
item.description: NumPy on Emscripten-forge now links OpenBLAS in WebAssembly, with large speedups for matmul and linear algebra in the browser. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Page Rage: Take Out Your Stress on a Web Page
item.description: Page Rage is a free game that lets you destroy any page. Dealing with things in a healthy way is overrated. Hide from your problems and break things instead! (1 source: frontendfocus)
